## Summary

Describe the user-visible or technical change.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm format:check`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` when UI or flows changed

## Privacy and security

- [ ] No secrets or birth data in code, fixtures, logs, analytics, screenshots, or error reports.
- [ ] Server-side validation and authorization considered.
- [ ] Documentation and ADRs updated when a decision changed.

## Deployment notes

Mention migrations, environment variables, or manual Coolify steps. Do not include secret values.
